name.value: Maple Leaf Motel & RV Park Resort

description.value: Maple Leaf Motel is a renovated motel and RV campground in Oliver, BC — Canada's self-styled Wine Capital — situated along Highway 97 close to more than 40 wineries. The property offers a range of room types, many with full kitchenettes, plus a heated outdoor pool shared with the RV campground. It is a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan wine corridor.

raw_osm.name: Maple Leaf Motel & RV Park Resort

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed room and facility information. Laundry is confirmed via the campground park policies page ('Coin operated laundry is available on site') and Wi-Fi via the rooms description ('free Wi-Fi'). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. Two discrepancies were noted: the OSM name uses 'RV Park Resort' while the website consistently uses 'RV Campground', and the postal code differs (OSM: V0H 1T0; website contact page: V0H 1T1).
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Maple Leaf Motel & RV Park Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Maple Leaf Motel & RV Campground' (and occasionally 'Maple Leaf Motel & Rv Campground Resort' on the contact page).
Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V0H 1T0; website contact page shows V0H 1T1.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible motel and RV campground with a functioning website and online booking. A practical overnight option for touring cyclists in the Okanagan.

Laundry.detail: Campground park policies page states: 'Coin operated laundry is available on site.'
